hook_text: I joined a puddle jumping league

song.title: Puddle League
song.style: English, bouncy two-tone ska with offbeat guitar, walking bass, bright trombone and trumpet stabs, warm friendly male lead vocal, playful and cheeky, 126 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Rain came down on Sunday noon
I was scrolling through the gloom
Window showed a silver street
Something tickled in my feet

[Chorus]
Jump in, jump in, make a splash
Soggy socks and muddy mash
Jump in, jump in, one, two, three
Puddle league has room for me

[Verse]
Left my phone to dry inside
Found my boots and off I slide
Grandma brought her yellow hat
Baker's dog went splash like that

[Chorus]
Jump in, jump in, make a splash
Whole street in a muddy bash
Jump in, jump in, rain or sun
Infinite stroll has just begun

shots.prompt: Rain pours down on a street of crooked clay houses, fat drops bouncing off the cobblestones and filling a row of puddles. The camera cranes down fast from the grey sky to the street. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.
{moss} slumps on a green sofa beside a rainy window, his face lit by a softly glowing phone in his hands. The camera pushes in. Dim grey light, warm lamp.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, bored and droopy on a green sofa, a softly glowing phone in his hand. The camera pushes in slowly. Dim grey light, warm lamp.
A chunky plasticine thumb flicks up and up on a softly glowing phone. Extreme close-up, the camera spins around the thumb. Dim grey light.
{moss} presses his nose against a rainy window and looks out at a shining wet street full of puddles. The camera dollies in toward the glass. Silver rain light.
A single big raindrop lands in a puddle and a perfect ring spreads out. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Silver light.
A pair of green rubber boots by a front door wobble and hop on their own with excitement. Close-up, the camera whip-pans down to them. Warm hallway light.
{moss} jumps up off the green sofa with a big idea, tossing a cushion in the air. The camera crash zooms in. Warm lamp light.
shots.frame: He sits bolt upright on a green sofa with wide eyes and a big smile, a cushion beside him, a rainy window behind. Medium shot. Warm lamp light.

shots.prompt: {moss} leaps off a front step and lands with both boots in a big puddle, water exploding outward. The camera crash zooms in low. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.
shots.frame: He is in mid-air, jumping off a front step above a big puddle on a rainy cobbled street, arms up, grinning. Full body. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.

shots.prompt: A wave of muddy puddle water flies straight at the camera and splashes over it. The camera shakes. Silver rain light.
{moss} stomps in a muddy puddle, mud splattering up his mustard raincoat as he laughs. The camera orbits fast around him. Silver rain light.
shots.frame: He stomps in a muddy puddle on a rainy cobbled street of crooked houses, one boot raised, mud splattered up his raincoat, laughing. Full body. Silver rain light.

shots.prompt: Two clay hands wring out a soggy grey sock, water streaming down. Extreme close-up, the camera tilts down with the water. Warm light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, rain dripping off his beanie, holding up three fingers. The camera pushes in fast. Silver rain light, warm glow.
{moss} hops across three puddles in a row like stepping stones, splash, splash, splash. The camera tracks beside him. Silver rain light.
shots.frame: He stands on one leg at the edge of the first of three puddles in a row on a rainy cobbled street, seen from the side, about to hop. Full body. Silver rain light.

shots.prompt: {moss} stands proudly in the middle of a puddle with his hands on his hips while rain falls around him. The camera cranes up and away. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.
A row of little paper boats bobs along a rain-filled gutter. Close-up, the camera tracks with them. Silver rain light.
A phone lies face down on a folded towel on a kitchen table, fast asleep, rain running down the window behind it. The camera pulls back slowly. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} steps out of his front door into the rain with a huge grin, arms wide. The camera whip-pans from the door to the street. Silver rain light.
{moss} slides along a wet cobbled street on his green boots like an ice skater, arms out for balance. The camera tracks fast beside him. Silver rain light.
{moss} skids to a stop at the edge of an enormous puddle and gasps with delight. The camera dolly zooms on him. Silver rain light.

A grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat marches out of her front door and jumps into a puddle next to {moss}. The camera whip-pans to her. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.
shots.frame: He stands in a puddle on a rainy cobbled street, looking delighted at a grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat who is stepping out of her front door beside him. Full body. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.

shots.prompt: A grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat laughs with her head thrown back, soaked. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm window glow.
A scruffy brown dog with a red collar runs and belly-flops into a puddle with a huge splash beside a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat. The camera crash zooms in. Silver rain light.
{moss} wipes muddy water off his round glasses and bursts out laughing. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Silver rain light.
shots.frame: He stands on a rainy cobbled street of crooked houses wiping muddy water off his round glasses with one hand, laughing. Medium shot. Silver rain light.

shots.prompt: Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, soaked and joyful, pumping his fists in the air. The camera orbits around him. Silver rain light, warm glow.

{moss}, a grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat all jump into one big puddle at the same moment. The camera crash zooms in low. Silver rain light.
shots.frame: He stands at the edge of a big puddle on a rainy street between a grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat, all three crouched and ready to jump. Full body. Silver rain light.

shots.prompt: {moss} splashes down the middle of a street of crooked clay houses with a grandma in a purple cardigan, pearl glasses and a big yellow rain hat and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat jumping in puddles on either side of him. The camera tracks backward fast in front of them. Silver rain light, warm lit windows.
Muddy boot prints dance across wet cobblestones. Close-up, the camera tracks along them. Silver light.
The rain stops and a bright rainbow arches over wet rooftops as sunbeams break through the clouds. The camera cranes up. Golden light after rain.
{moss} looks up at the sky from the middle of a puddle, soaked and smiling, steam rising off his raincoat in the sun. The camera pushes in. Golden light after rain.

A cream t-shirt with a hills-and-infinity-path illustration and the words Infinite Stroll hangs on a clothesline between two houses, swaying gently in the sun beside a pair of green socks. The camera drifts slowly toward it. Golden light after rain.
{moss_back} walks away down a shining wet street toward a rainbow, puddles reflecting the golden sky, taking a deep breath. The camera cranes slowly up. Golden light after rain.

caption: it rained all sunday so moss started a puddle league. grandma is undefeated. dry off in the Infinite Stroll tee
